entities.name: General Stonebrow
entities.description: Leader of the Cailgreth centaurs of the Krosan forest on Otaria, morphed into a giant by Kamahl.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: Pit fighter who morphed Stonebrow and used Soul Reaper to create Karona.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: Kamahl's sister, whom he went to Aphetto to reclaim.

entities.name: Zagorka
entities.description: Fled with Stonebrow and found Sanctum; later cleaved by Kamahl.

entities.name: Akroma
entities.description: Wounded angel Stonebrow conspired to slay; cleaved by Kamahl to create Karona.

entities.name: Phage
entities.description: Pregnant, cleaved by Kamahl to create Karona.

entities.name: Karona
entities.description: False god created when Kamahl cleaved Phage, Akroma and Zagorka.

entities.name: Cailgreth centaurs
entities.description: Centaur tribe of the Krosan Forest led by Stonebrow.

entities.name: Soul Reaper
entities.description: Axe carried by Stonebrow and returned to Kamahl.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: Artifact Kamahl used to amplify Krosan creatures.

entities.name: Sanctum
entities.description: Ancient lost city discovered by Stonebrow and Zagorka.

entities.name: Topos
entities.description: Place Stonebrow stewarded in Akroma's absence.

entities.name: Averru
entities.description: City where Karona was; site of final battle against Karona's War.

entities.name: Aphetto
entities.description: Place Kamahl went to reclaim Jeska.

events.summary: Stonebrow becomes Kamahl's right hand after Seton's death.
Stonebrow serves as general of Kamahl's army at Aphetto and fights in the Nightmare War.
events.quote: Stonebrow served as the general of the strange army brought to Aphetto

events.summary: Stonebrow and Zagorka flee and discover the lost city of Sanctum.
events.quote: discovered the ancient lost city of Sanctum

events.summary: Stonebrow abandons his post at Topos, disgusted at conspiring to slay Akroma and Phage.
events.quote: he abandoned the post after becoming disgusted with himself

events.summary: Stonebrow returns Soul Reaper to Kamahl, who cleaves Phage, Akroma and Zagorka to create Karona.
events.quote: thus creating the false god Karona

events.summary: Stonebrow survives the Rebirth of Karona with two broken legs.
events.quote: he survived, albeit with two broken legs

events.summary: Stonebrow joins the forces of Averru in the last battle against Karona's War and survives.
events.quote: joining in the last battle against Karona's War at that site

relations.quote: was the leader of the Cailgreth centaurs

relations.note: by cleaving Phage, Akroma and Zagorka
relations.quote: thus creating the false god Karona
the death of the centaur elder Seton at the hands of the dementia summoner Braids
